COMPUTER STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

2. When learning Central Processing Unit, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Central Processing Unit.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Central Processing Unit.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Central Processing Unit.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Central Processing Unit.

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

4. When learning Computer storage, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer storage.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer storage.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer storage.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer storage.

5. When learning Data communication, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Data communication.

6. When learning Computer set up, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer set up.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer set up.

7. When learning Data Transmission Media, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

8. When learning Evolution and Development of Computers, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Evolution and Development of Computers.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Evolution and Development of Computers.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Evolution and Development of Computers.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Evolution and Development of Computers.

9. When learning Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.

10. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. CPU

11. When learning Input/Output Devices, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Input/Output Devices.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Input/Output Devices.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Input/Output Devices.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Input/Output Devices.

12. When learning Computer Organisation and Architecture, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Organisation and Architecture.

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Organisation and Architecture.

13. When learning Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.

14. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

15. When learning Operating System, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

16. When learning Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.

----
